recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless BRR wants a separate editorial pass to align individual short descriptions with the 2021 minutes wording verbatim.
issue_request: FHIR-31726 was a Published/Persuasive BRR clarification raised against R4B MedicinalProduct and applied for R5. It asked that short descriptions for attributes use words beyond the attribute name rather than simply repeating it; the recorded resolution was to improve the definitions.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly referencing FHIR-31726 was found. Jira records an applied comment on 2022-02-02, BRR minutes from 2021-08-10 record work on MedicinalProductDefinition attribute descriptions for FHIR-31726, and nearby January/February 2022 MedicinalProductDefinition history includes short-description and definition cleanup commits such as the FHIR#31798 short-definition work. The R5 release source contains the resulting non-trivial short descriptions.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicinalproductdefinition as an active resource and maps the old MedicinalProduct name to MedicinalProductDefinition, so the current build-scope artifact is MedicinalProductDefinition. Current source has explanatory short descriptions for the fields named in the BRR minutes. A direct source scan found 49 MPD elements and zero short descriptions equal only to their element leaf names. Zulip searches found no contrary discussion, and Confluence references show the issue was moved to R5 and later discussed with concrete MPD field wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already satisfies the issue intent, and forcing exact alignment with the 2021 meeting wording would be editorial churn rather than a necessary correction to implementer understanding.
